name: FATCA Form Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) form.

CER5.name: Certificate Foreign Intermediary
CER5.definition: Certificate of foreign intermediary (also known as IRS form W-8IMY).

CER7.name: Certificate Foreign Persons Claim
CER7.definition: Certificate of foreign person's claim that income is effectively connected with the conduct of a trade or business in the United States (also known as IRS form W-8BEN-E).

CER1.name: Certificate Foreign Status Beneficial Owner
CER1.definition: Certificate of foreign status of beneficial owner (also known as IRS form W-8BEN).

CER4.name: Self Certification Loss Nationality
CER4.definition: Self certificate of loss of nationality (also known as IRS form I-407).

CER6.name: Taxpayer Identification Number Request
CER6.definition: Form is a request for taxpayer identification number and certification (also known as IRS form W9).
